My first Voat post. Hi to everyone, its nice to be here.

I work for a huge multi-national company that makes enterprise software. What is enterprise software? Its like normal software but probably the WORST SOFTWARE YOU WILL EVER USE.

If you work for a mid to large corporate entity you have probably interacted with enterprise software. ERP systems, HR systems, invoicing systems, payroll systems, inventory stocking systems, call centre management systems...basically any kind of business software that you would never ever install on your personal computer at home.

If you've used this software, you'll be aware of two things;

  • Its almost universally shit. The interface sucks, its hard to enter data and impossible to get data out. It looks like it was designed in the 1980s (protip: it was designed in the 1980s).

  • MONEY. Enterprise software is expensive. Excel costs $100. The shitty webapp you have to use for invoicing, billing and inventory? It probably cost between $500k-$20m.

I know that many of you are forced to endure enterprise software as part of your job. I know it is painful and frustrating. And I'm sorry for that. I've seen people fly into apoplectic rages and break down sobbing during training sessions. I dont feel good about it.

Anyway, I am part of the sausage factory that generates this digital misery. Ask me anything.

Or if you just feel like venting about some shitty software you use at work, thats fine - go ahead. I can empathise.
